note: The closed list of idea topics, in the order the topics page shows them. One topic per idea. This file is the single source of truth: build.js, scripts/tag_topics.py and scripts/validate_ideas.py all read it, so the list cannot drift between them. When the list grows, do not run a full scripts/tag_topics.py --retag: on 26 Nov 2026 it moved 91 of the 601 archived ideas between old topics, because the tagger answers differently on a second run. Tag only the ideas without a topic (a plain run), preview the rest with --retag --sample 1000 (it writes nothing), and copy into ideas/topics.json only the ideas the preview moves into the new topic. Renaming a topic means renaming it in ideas/topics.json too.
